location: Room SZ, Mathematisches Institut, University of Göttingen

about.text: An introduction to Lorentzian and semi-Riemannian geometry, the geometry behind general relativity: causal structure, geodesics and completeness, and the global theory of Lorentzian manifolds. In the second half of the course, students studied a paper or topic in groups and presented it in class.

gradingNotes: Evaluation is by a project: each group is assigned a paper, presents it in class, and submits a detailed write-up. Both the presentation and the report count.
